currentWork.title: Operational evidence accumulation — FINAL.20 HF2 product-master sync verified
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.20 HF2 is merged and production/live verified. Confirmed OCR sales/input/recovery reports now synchronize discovered products into the Analytics product master without changing inventory quantities. Draft/unconfirmed OCR reports are explicitly excluded. Analysis > Inventory exposes a searchable Product Master and unconfirmed-classification entry point. Product-name heuristics can propose classifications such as coffee/black/unsweetened or low-sugar, but proposals remain unconfirmed until explicit user confirmation. Vehicle stocktake search now sees synchronized OCR products. Product listing order is natural product-code order, then smaller detected container size, then maker/name. PR #121 merged at 9b5ecdef5bca48347c98c5d995cb23d0f81be015; Vercel production deployment dpl_2E6Zj35tLsjafLSp4tmk6Ycv475Y is READY; the dedicated gate passes on production and GitHub Pages. App/engine/DB/schema remain FINAL.20 / AN14B3B5 / 4 / 4.
scope: Use VENDRIVE normally; no active feature phase is open.
Only confirmed OCR reports may add/update product-master discovery data; draft OCR candidates must not leak into the master.
Classification inference is proposal-only until explicit human confirmation.
Product master and vehicle stocktake search include synchronized OCR products.
Product lists use product-code natural order, then smaller detected size, then maker/name.
Keep inventory movement semantics, report confirmation boundaries, learned numeric forecasting, Analytics engine, DB and schema unchanged.
nextActions: Use the new Product Master from Analysis > Inventory to search and confirm classifications where useful.
